CLASSES.name: Cleric
CLASSES.desc: Faith in a god that no longer listens.

CLASSES.name: Wretch
CLASSES.desc: Nothing to lose. Everything to become.

QUESTS.title: A Bell Without a Voice
QUESTS.desc: Find Sister Vael by the ruined sanctuary. She remembers those who came before you.

QUESTS.title: The Cost of a Crown
QUESTS.desc: Captain Edrin holds the gates of Crownfall. Hear his request before choosing a side.

QUESTS.title: The Unwritten Prophecy
QUESTS.desc: Find the fragments of the first account. History has been altered.

REGIONS.name: The Ashen Veil
REGIONS.lore: No bell has rung here in nine hundred years. Yet the villagers still cover their ears at dusk.
REGIONS.npcText: You have no shadow in the firelight. Neither did the last one. Take the northern road, if you must. But do not give the bell your name.
REGIONS.secret: Behind the broken arch, a mason hid a fragment of the first throne.

REGIONS.name: The Hollowwood
REGIONS.lore: The trees wear the faces of those who fed them. Some are still speaking.
REGIONS.npcText: Mother says the trees are hungry. I tell them stories so they forget. Will you leave a memory, or take a knife?
REGIONS.secret: Strike the pale tree beyond the western trail to find the drowned crypt.

REGIONS.name: Crownfall Citadel
REGIONS.lore: The king promised his people eternity. Every locked house contains proof that he kept his word.
REGIONS.npcText: A crown is only a circle of metal until someone bleeds for it. Help me open the gates. Or leave them sealed, and keep the city alive.
REGIONS.secret: A false wall below the western tower conceals the king’s confession.
REGIONS.mechanic: Sentinels guard and counter repeated strikes.

REGIONS.name: The Weeping Mire
REGIONS.lore: The saint healed a thousand plague victims. The swamp remembers what she asked in return.
REGIONS.npcText: The dead pay in names. The living pay in promises. Tell me which you have left.
REGIONS.secret: Follow the lanterns at night to the sunken sanctuary.
REGIONS.mechanic: Standing in marsh pools inflicts poison.

REGIONS.name: Frostveil Peaks
REGIONS.sub: The last breath of a god
REGIONS.lore: The mountain is not stone. The miners realized this when their tunnels began to heal.
REGIONS.npcText: There is a heartbeat beneath the ice. I have listened for thirty years. Yesterday, it missed a beat.
REGIONS.secret: An ice wall opens beneath a charged weapon strike.

REGIONS.name: Nacreth, the Below
REGIONS.lore: They carved out their eyes so they would never see the sky fall again.
REGIONS.npcText: Seven thrones, the surface says. But our oldest songs count eight. Someone has edited your history.
REGIONS.secret: Three broken pillars point toward the oracle’s sealed library.

REGIONS.name: The Cinder Wastes
REGIONS.lore: The first pyromancers stole fire from a dying sun. It has been looking for them ever since.
REGIONS.npcText: Everything has a price. Even an ending. Especially an ending.
REGIONS.secret: The coldest stone in the wastes hides a passage under the lava.
REGIONS.mechanic: Lava scorches. Rain weakens flame magic.

REGIONS.name: The Nameless Expanse
REGIONS.sub: Every grain was once a memory
REGIONS.lore: A civilization wished to be forgotten. The desert is the shape of that wish.
REGIONS.npcText: I wrote the prophecy. Or someone wrote me remembering that I wrote it. Burn this page before you believe it.
REGIONS.secret: At dusk the temple’s shadow reveals a buried stair.
REGIONS.mechanic: Sand obscures enemies at a distance.

REGIONS.name: The Sunless Sea
REGIONS.sub: An ocean that has never known a sky
REGIONS.lore: The tide rises toward the ceiling. Sailors pray that it never reaches it.
REGIONS.npcText: My mother waits below. She is wearing the sea as a skin. Please, let her sleep.
REGIONS.secret: A drowned doorway appears only after meeting the ferryman.

REGIONS.name: Temple of the First Dawn
REGIONS.lore: The angels did not fall. They were thrown.
REGIONS.npcText: The gods feared death until they learned what came after. Now they fear life.
REGIONS.secret: Kneel before the empty altar to open the reliquary.

REGIONS.name: The Archive of Echoes
REGIONS.sub: The past is still happening here
REGIONS.lore: Every book ends with your name. No two books agree on what you did.
REGIONS.npcText: You are not the first to reach this room. You are the first who was allowed to remember it.
REGIONS.secret: Choose silence when the archive asks your name.

REGIONS.name: The Eclipse Bastion
REGIONS.lore: The bastion casts a shadow toward the sun. No cartographer will draw it twice.
REGIONS.npcText: You opened a gate once. Now every gate is open. Was it mercy, or were you simply curious?
REGIONS.secret: A reflection opens the passage that stone conceals.

REGIONS.name: The Fractured Throne
REGIONS.lore: Seven empty seats surround an eighth shadow. The prophecy has no words for this place.
REGIONS.npcText: It was never a throne. It was a lock. You have carried the keys so faithfully.
REGIONS.secret: The true account requires seven shards and seven acts of mercy.

WEAPONS.name: Oathkeeper
WEAPONS.lore: A knight’s final promise, hammered into iron.

WEAPONS.name: Twin Fangs
WEAPONS.lore: The second wound arrives before the first is felt.

WEAPONS.name: Griefbringer
WEAPONS.lore: Forged from the gates of a city that never surrendered.

WEAPONS.name: Moonlit Edge
WEAPONS.lore: A blade that remembers a moon the sky has forgotten.

WEAPONS.name: Ashwood Staff
WEAPONS.lore: Its roots drink the last light of a buried star.

WEAPONS.name: Widow’s Kiss
WEAPONS.lore: The handle is warm. It always has been.

WEAPONS.name: Dawn Mace
WEAPONS.lore: A prayer that learned to answer itself.

WEAPONS.name: Weathered Club
WEAPONS.lore: Something to hold against the end of everything.

WEAPONS.name: King’s Lament
WEAPONS.lore: Nine hundred names are inscribed on its edge.

WEAPONS.name: Sunbreaker
WEAPONS.lore: A dying sun still burns inside.

WEAPONS.name: Hourglass Pike
WEAPONS.lore: Its tip strikes a moment before it moves.

WEAPONS.name: Tidecaller
WEAPONS.lore: You can hear the sea, but there is no shell.

WEAPONS.name: Pilgrim’s Bow
WEAPONS.lore: For the roads that do not lead home.

WEAPONS.name: Gravebolt
WEAPONS.lore: One bolt for the living. Two for the dead.
